capSemanticsReview.rationale: Pinned ethereum block 26113624 (hash 0xa8237b00d3c3b45acd6b8c3284c68a98037052ea7447b7674ce460b207a33ca2). The pinned immutable VaultV2 source routes deposit/mint through enter(), which transfers underlying assets before createShares(). Curator increaseAbsoluteCap/increaseRelativeCap and addAdapter govern allocation limits, not arbitrary recipient minting; owner/curator, deposit-gate and fee-recipient settings cannot bypass this accounting. accrueInterest() separately creates fee shares under immutable MAX_PERFORMANCE_FEE (50% of interest) and MAX_MANAGEMENT_FEE (5% annualized) limits, not discretionary arbitrary-share issuance. There is no local upgrade entrypoint. Inherited controls concern pyusd-paypal, whose parent issuance is carried by the serial-claim dependency, not wrapper-local D14.

Source review distinguishes sendAssetsGate (deposits) from permanently abdicated receiveAssetsGate (withdrawals); no future gate-setting withdrawal power is claimed. At pinned block 26107702, full deployment-history role logs and current mapping reads establish allocator and sentinel authority. Allocator can allocate/deallocate within caps, change liquidityAdapter/data and maxRate without delay; this can affect future fee accrual and cash-exit routing but is not arbitrary share minting. Sentinel can deallocate, reduce caps and revoke pending changes.

review.evidence: Pinned block 26107702 confirms native asset, immutable source, zero proxy slots, separate 1-of-1 owner/curator Safes, empty signer EOA code, no modules and zero guards. performanceFee=150000000000000000; managementFee=0 (contract-native units). Fee-share issuance is not omitted; zero-delay fee and deposit-gate parameter changes remain concentrated economic controls. Parent reserve reports are not exact-vault financial reconciliation. Rechecked 2026-10-03 at the same pin: owner and curator each have threshold 1 and one owner; getModulesPaginated(0x1,100) reaches sentinel 0x1 with no modules. addAdapter and increaseAbsoluteCap delays are 259200s; setPerformanceFee, setManagementFee and setSendAssetsGate delays are zero. The sendAssetsGate restricts deposit/mint, not withdrawal/redeem; receiveAssetsGate and share-gate setters are permanently abdicated. Sentora terms assert non-custody but do not negate on-chain allocation and fee authority. Complete constructor-to-pin SetIsAllocator/SetIsSentinel log scan, followed by isAllocator/isSentinel reads, establishes allocators [0x9e396de3312d373b87f9bd8763fb48184b42aac0, 0xc4ba4e822c420452fe2bab93211208d3ccbd79d3] and sentinels [0x9e396de3312d373b87f9bd8763fb48184b42aac0, 0x74d1672d0b90f6e7c322dec9d5396ff6ace61618]. Registry 0x3696c5eae4a7ffd04ea163564571e9cd8ed9364e has owner 0xcba28b38103307ec8da98377fff9816c164f9afa and current subregistries [0xa31788949d0fe443d3d1033222fc9479499bc3f5, 0xcef9ee779ef9428f50bb7a21b3e3b4efdbc33844, 0xca38e878439e02f2feb364a2b36b52789f983727, 0xfb4d38d93736a040993c50aaac776a2be2cff8be]. Calibration v1 moved signer/key-custody nondisclosure outside the aggregate mint-closure flag; v2 records it on each identified owner/curator Safe as a sourced scoped question: Who controls the two sole signer EOAs organizationally, and what independently attested key custody protects them? Sentora terms do not identify the key holders. Calibration v2 restores the unresolved registry/subregistry authorization and any delegated allocator execution census to unresolvedQuestions; known controller types are not relabeled unknown. Reconciliation remains not-applicable to native asset-backed share/fee accounting; exact-vault financial assurance and holder recovery are Backing gaps. Supervision remains none, so no prudential or attestation-only credit is claimed.
